text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: SDL Abuse is an open-source port of the classic 1996 action platform game Abuse. Originally developed by Crack dot Com, Abuse combined fast run-and-gun gameplay with detailed 2D graphics, fluid character movement, and a unique control system that allowed players to aim independently with the mouse while moving with the keyboard. The SDL version updates the original DOS game for modern systems, improving compatibility and adding support for current operating systems while preserving the original levels, artwork, and gameplay.
